title: Concurrent production of diesel valeric biofuel and a fuel additive in a one-pot process over SiO2–Al2O3-supported catalysts: influence of the Si/Al ratio
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, 8,5785-5792
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01155D, Communication
Francisco Agustín Martínez, Darío Jobino Segobia, Nicolás Maximiliano Bertero
The co-production of pentyl valerate biofuel and the diesel additive di-n-pentyl ether from γ-valerolactone, pentanol and H2 in a one-pot process is reported for the first time, analyzing the influence of the Si/Al ratio of the SiO2–Al2O3 support.
